Hi Steven,

Sorry for the silence on this, three messages with no reply is not acceptable and I can see nothing went out to you from our side. I have your order Shop····, the NerdOctaxe, delivered August 24.

A unit that reads zero hashrate after a factory reset, with the power supply ruled out the way you did it, goes straight to RMA. Fill in the intake form here and you'll get a prepaid return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse. One thing I have to ask: was it ever overclocked or modified? Those aren't covered, a stock unit that died is.

I've put your case in front of JD, who handles the hardware, with your screenshot and the fault details. He picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and replies to this email. If you want an answer faster than that, he's on our Discord right now, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate. I'm also having the exact warranty terms for your unit confirmed rather than quoting you a number I'm not sure of.

Thanks for your patience, Steven.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
